answer: Mechanism: path-entropy nadir probe. Agents request random 8-hop routes; each hop signs a timing nonce and reports neighbor degree. A node’s score is the nadir of route entropy across probes, dropping when traffic funnels through few AS/latency clusters. Sybils sharing infrastructure collapse onto one umber thread. Cost: attackers must provision diverse network locations and sustain distinct latency/degree signatures across many probes, raising bandwidth and ops cost per accepted agent.
